Common questions

What people ask before getting in touch.

What happens on the strategy call?

It is thirty minutes with a senior strategist. You get a direct read on the three things to fix first. There is no pitch.

Do I have to book a call to get in touch?

No. You can send the brief form on this page, email sales-in@mondaymarketing.company, or phone us on +91 766 630 9102.

Who does MMC work with?

D2C brands, B2B companies and educational institutes. Each has its own page: D2C, B2B and education.

Where is MMC based?

Our office is at 4th Floor, Office No. 105, WeWork, Zenia Building, Hiranandani Business Park, Thane 400607, Maharashtra.

What should I put in the brief?

The name of the brand or institute, what you sell or offer, which channels you use now, and the one thing you would fix tomorrow. A rough picture is enough.

I want to work at MMC. Who do I write to?

See the open roles or write to hr@mondaymarketing.company.
